title: Differences between all the Claude tools
description: Differences between all the Claude tools
transcript: Chat is for thinking, co-work is for organizing, code is for building stuff. Chat is for words, co-work is for files, code is for apps. Chat for the idea, co-work for the clean-up, code to actually build the product. Chat for research, co-work for sorting through things, code for creating. Claude chat is your brains, co-work are your hands, Claude code that's like a factory that builds stuff.
